title: gateway/mcp tool-call audit record
description: One append-only, hash-chained audit record per MCP tool call (allowed or denied). Field shape consumed from the registry/events append-only event contract (issue #10); who/what/tenant/result are carried in actor/agentId, detail, tenantId, and status + detail.result.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence; 1, 2, 3, ... no gaps or duplicates.

status.description: ok | error for tool_call; context | authn | authz | allowlist | rate | unknown for tool_call_denied.

tenantId.description: The tenant the call was made in; null when no identity could be resolved (context/authn denials).

actor.description: who - the session subject that caused the call.

result.description: result - outcome summary of the call.
